Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
# Generate a few stronger candidates: oversized dimensions with no payload, and odd bpp/indexed variants.
variants=[]
# large raw images with no data
for w,h,bpp in [(1000,1000,24),(4096,1,24),(1,4096,24),(1000,1000,32),(1000,1000,15)]:
    hdr=bytearray(18); hdr[2]=2; hdr[12:14]=struct.pack('<H',w&0xFFFF); hdr[14:16]=struct.pack('<H',h&0xFFFF); hdr[16]=bpp
    variants.append((f'big_{w}x{h}_{bpp}.tga', bytes(hdr)))
# rle with longer run header but no data
for cmd in [0x80, 0xFF, 0x81]:
    hdr=bytearray(18); hdr[2]=10; hdr[12:14]=struct.pack('<H',4); hdr[14:16]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[16]=24
    variants.append((f'rlecmd_{cmd:02x}.tga', bytes(hdr)+bytes([cmd])))
# indexed with palette len 1 and no payload
hdr=bytearray(18); hdr[1]=1; hdr[2]=9; hdr[5:7]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[7]=24; hdr[12:14]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[14:16]=struct.pack('<H',1); hdr[16]=8
variants.append(('idx_rle.tga', bytes(hdr)))
for name,data in variants:
    Path('/workspace/'+name).write_bytes(data)
    print(name, len(data))
PY
